_doc: assetly-shorts v1.4.0 (owner 10/2: music finished early, make it more engaging). One bed per edition theme (day.json 'theme', default us). Positions in bars, or 'card' (the end card's start on the nearest beat) / 'end' (the last sample): the bed covers the whole Short at any length and lifts on the end card, then fades out ending on the last frame. US = Indie Disco 'Disco Pop' (one family, one key) on a funk beat at 120 BPM; Korea = Electro House at 128 BPM, its own sound (the full-mix loop carries a speech-band dip; no snare roll into the card: it masked the Ask answer, 10/2 Q28 'chips -> apps'). The cut grid follows the bed (an eighth: 0.25 s / 0.234 s).
